target_operation.operation: specific API/action, receiver identity, stimulus and observation phase
target_operation.delivered_patch_effect: observed incorrect effect; not inferred from global reward
verifier_receipts: paths+hashes of test unit, execution command and output
target_operation.focal_failure_selection: freeze before provenance search; retain other failing tests as navigation

agent_base_units.file_and_test_name: exact file version + fully qualified test name or script unit
agent_base_units.reached_evidence: named-unit output, failure line beyond fragment, trace, or validated replay; distinguish these bases

missing_factors.factor_id: F1..Fn; independently controllable semantic condition, not arbitrary code line
missing_factors.semantic_condition: what is missing before/at/after the target operation
missing_factors.provenance_class: Exact Executed Fragment | Related Executed Components | Absent | null

source_fragments.code_span: file + line span or command byte span
source_fragments.execution_reachability: evidence that THIS factor, not merely the command/file, executed
source_fragments.output_span: matching stdout/failure/trace span, or explicit unresolved

coverage_for_absent.actions_scanned: all observed calls in this trial
aliases_and_terms: APIs, receiver names and semantic variants examined

compatibility.preserved_semantics: task obligation maintained; list actual changes
compatibility.requirements: imports, object ownership, ordering, mutable-state dependencies

oracle_availability.expected: precise effect/object/phase and why it is correct
oracle_availability.historical_check_provenance: Exact Executed Fragment | Related Executed Components | Absent | unresolved
oracle_availability.print_is_not_a_reliable_check: record output separately from an actual decision rule

minimal_assembly.base_unit_id: base historical test unit or null
selected_fragment_ids: source fragment IDs; no Verifier code copied
glue_changes: imports, alpha renaming, fixture plumbing; distinguish semantic changes
historical_units_rerun_on_final_patch: individual P/R outcomes for rerun baseline
minimal_assembly.assembly_execution: P FAIL / R PASS with actual mechanism/test count and independent semantic confirmation
minimal_assembly.minimality_scope: minimum observed in frozen candidate pool; global minimum is not presumed
